explanation: This pole fires on the head noun of a partitive or grouping phrase when the noun belongs to a small memorized lexeme set of collection-arrangement words (series, set, row, bunch, variety, range, batch, type, and the fixed item carrion, with non-English counterparts such as 种, Teil and 局), with strength gated by determiner and noun sense: plain or upcoming determiners (a, first, next) pass while distributive/final ones (each, last) and non-collection senses (mountain range, variety show, range cooker, batch-as-verb) suppress it, and near-synonyms outside the set (string, number, wave, lot, group, carcass, corpse) stay silent. It peaks on the noun itself in a single g+u+ SwiGLU regime (silence comes from an up-projection veto while the gate still recognizes the lexeme) and its output damps the default 'of' continuation, so it reacts to the current phrase rather than preparing any specific upcoming token.
